title: Noctusense
subtitle: 10 Years on Padang · 2016 — 2026
description_en:
Ten years beneath the same flag.

From 2016 to 2026, NOCTUSENSE has been part of the Padang Records story — not only as an artist, but as one of the minds that helped shape an important chapter of our sound.

As compiler and curator of Haunted Spectre, our most acclaimed Dark Progressive compilation series, Ronaldo played a fundamental role in pushing Padang into new territory. Through its releases and continuity, Haunted Spectre became more than a series — it helped define an era of the label and the darker path we chose to explore.

From Brazil’s Northeast, Noctusense has also remained one of the few pirates carrying the Padang flag across the region, extending this story far beyond our usual waters.

Ten years of music, friendship, discovery and shared vision.

Some journeys deserve no monument.
They deserve to be played loud.

NOCTUSENSE — Celebrating 10 Years on Padang Records
2016 — 2026
PADANG LABS | EP.23

title: Secular Bonzo
subtitle: Live Recorded at Syncronic - Padang x Blacklite
description_en:
SECULAR BONZO | PADANG LAB SERIES

For this recording, Secular Bonzo presents a live journey designed to explore the deeper edges of the Padang sound, moving through hypnotic Dark Prog atmospheres, psychedelic textures, and organic Forest influences with a fluid and carefully constructed progression.

Built as a continuous narrative rather than a sequence of tracks, the set unfolds gradually between tension and release, dense grooves and immersive ambiences, reflecting the project’s approach to storytelling on the dancefloor.

Rooted in the underground culture of Southern Brazil and shaped by years of dancefloor experience, Secular Bonzo translates the essence of the Padang universe into a ritualistic and driving live performance, intense, atmospheric and deeply psychedelic.

This recording is a direct reflection of the project’s identity. Raw, immersive and conceived for real dancefloors.
description_pt:
Para esta gravação, Secular Bonzo apresenta uma jornada ao vivo concebida para explorar as camadas mais profundas da sonoridade da Padang, transitando entre atmosferas hipnóticas de Dark Prog, texturas psicodélicas e influências orgânicas de Forest em uma progressão fluida e cuidadosamente construída.

Construído como uma narrativa contínua, e não apenas uma sequência de faixas, o set se desenvolve gradualmente entre tensão e liberação, grooves densos e ambiências imersivas, refletindo a abordagem do projeto em criar histórias através da pista de dança.

Enraizado na cultura underground do sul do Brasil e moldado por anos de experiência nas pistas, o Secular Bonzo traduz a essência do universo da Padang em uma performance ritualística e pulsante — intensa, atmosférica e profundamente psicodélica.

Esta gravação é um reflexo direto da identidade do projeto. Crua, imersiva e concebida para pistas de dança reais.
tracklist: Niobium & Secular Bonzo – The Original Equation (UNR)

title: Alex Alipe
subtitle: Live Recorded at Syncronic - Padang x Blacklite
description_en:
ALEX ALIPE | PADANG LAB SERIES

This special edition of the Padang Lab Series captures a unique moment from Syncronic — a collaborative night between Padang Records and Blacklite, where distinct underground identities converged into a single immersive experience.

For this set, Alex Alipe delivers a focused and intentional journey built exclusively around Padang Records’ catalogue, presenting the label’s sonic identity through his refined mixing approach and deep understanding of dancefloor dynamics.

Recognized as a Brazilian mixing champion in the psytrance category, Alex Alipe stands out for his technical precision and ability to craft cohesive, hypnotic narratives on the dancefloor. In this recording, he translates the Padang sound into a seamless flow of tension, groove, and depth.

The full lineup of the night featured:

DIENSTMANN
ALEX ALIPE
TENEBRA b2b TEKMALL
GREEN WAVES
SECULAR BONZO
SHOVE vs PIAZER
ABSTRACT MACHINE

More than a set, this is a curated perspective on the Padang universe — interpreted live, on a real dancefloor.

title: Macedo
subtitle: Free Download
description_en:
Immerse yourself in an electrifying journey across two underexplored realms of electronic music, as we begin our voyage in the darker, more profound recesses of techno, and gradually transition into the mystique of dark progressive psytrance. This particular DJ set, composed entirely of tracks released on Padang Records, is designed to lure you into an hypnotic state of mind.

Stepping away from the traditional mold of numerous breaks and drops, this set aims to create a more seamless auditory experience, characterized by its sustained intensity. With each beat and rhythm, you're brought deeper into the soundscape, allowing the music to speak volumes about this novel approach. Take a listen, and you'll understand the intriguing depth of this musical exploration.
